summary: The staff revised Section 9.1 and disagreed with Duke, stating that ecological considerations including botanical surveys should be part of the planning process for selecting any facility site, including access road routes.
text: Section 9.1 has been revised. Ecclegical considerations, including botanical surveys, should be a part of the planning process in selecting any ultimate facility site, including access road routes.
